name: @aux4/pdf
comment: @napi-rs/canvas ships a platform-specific native binary used only by 'aux4 pdf image'. The platform packages below are listed explicitly (and installed with 'npm install --force', which ignores the os/cpu mismatch) so the published package carries binaries for every supported platform instead of only the CI build host's. Windows is intentionally omitted (not fully supported). Keep @napi-rs/canvas and its platform packages pinned to the SAME exact version so the native ABI matches.
